tagline: An S&P 500 company that operates as a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust specializing in West Coast apartment communities
hero_kpi_rationale: Measures the organic performance of the stabilized real estate portfolio, reflecting rent growth on properties held for at least one year, excluding the impact of acquisitions and dispositions.
company_description: Essex Property Trust, Inc., an S&P 500 company, is a fully integrated real estate investment trust. The firm acquires, develops, redevelops, and manages multifamily residential properties in selected West Coast markets. Essex currently has ownership interests in 259 apartment communities comprising over 63,000 apartment homes with an additional property in active development. Essex Property Trust, Inc. was incorporated in 1971 and is based in San Mateo, United States.

events.title: Earnings Beat, Buybacks and Raised Guidance Might Change The Case For Investing In Essex Property Trust (ESS)
events.body: In the first quarter of 2026, Essex Property Trust reported higher revenue of US$484.76 million but lower net income of US$106.19 million, while also buying back 254,001 shares for US$61.91 million as part of a US$259.24 million repurchase
